project: Namias Portfolio V2 - Docker & Kubernetes Deployment
summary: Containerize the Next.js 16 portfolio application with Docker and deploy to Kubernetes with production-grade configuration including health checks, autoscaling, ingress with TLS, and CI/CD pipeline automation.
narrative: The portfolio currently runs on Cloudflare Workers via OpenNext adapter. While this provides excellent edge performance, containerizing with Docker and deploying to Kubernetes offers greater flexibility: custom runtime configurations, persistent caching, easier debugging, multi-environment support (staging/production), and the ability to run the full Node.js Next.js server with all features (API routes, ISR, middleware) without edge limitations. The Docker image will use multi-stage builds for minimal size, and Kubernetes manifests will follow production best practices with resource limits, health probes, horizontal pod autoscaling, and TLS-encrypted ingress.
principles: Multi-stage Docker builds for minimal image size and security
Production-ready Kubernetes manifests with resource limits and health checks
Horizontal Pod Autoscaling for traffic spikes
CI/CD pipeline for automated image builds and deployments
Health checks (liveness, readiness, startup) for reliability

epics.title: Docker Containerization
epics.summary: Create optimized multi-stage Dockerfile and docker-compose for local development and production builds.

stories.title: Create multi-stage Dockerfile
stories.details: Build stage with pnpm + Bun for registry build, production stage with Node.js 24-alpine. Copy only necessary artifacts (.next/standalone, public, static). Run as non-root user. Expose port 3000.

stories.title: Create .dockerignore
stories.details: Exclude node_modules, .next, .git, tests, docs, and dev files from Docker context to minimize build context size.

stories.title: Create docker-compose.yml for local dev
stories.details: Single-command local development with docker-compose. Mount source code for hot reload, expose port 3000, pass env vars from .env.local.

stories.title: Create Docker build script
stories.details: Shell script for building, tagging, and pushing Docker images. Supports version tags and latest tag.

epics.title: Kubernetes Manifests
epics.summary: Create production-grade Kubernetes manifests for deployment, service, ingress, configmap, secrets, HPA, and PDB.

stories.title: Create Namespace and ConfigMap
stories.details: Define 'namias' namespace. Create ConfigMap for non-sensitive environment variables (NEXT_PUBLIC_*, NODE_ENV, etc.).

stories.title: Create Secrets manifest
stories.details: Template for Kubernetes Secret with base64-encoded sensitive vars (API tokens, secrets). Include instructions for sealed-secrets or external-secrets.

stories.title: Create Deployment manifest
stories.details: Deployment with 2 replicas, resource requests/limits (128Mi-256Mi memory, 100m-500m CPU), liveness probe (/api/health), readiness probe (/api/health), startup probe, rolling update strategy (maxSurge: 1, maxUnavailable: 0).

stories.title: Create Service manifest
stories.details: ClusterIP service exposing port 80 -> 3000. Internal traffic routing.

stories.title: Create Ingress manifest with TLS
stories.details: Nginx Ingress with TLS termination via cert-manager. Host: namias.tech. Redirect HTTP -> HTTPS. Proxy headers for Next.js.

stories.title: Create HorizontalPodAutoscaler
stories.details: HPA scaling 2-10 pods based on CPU (target 70%) and memory (target 80%). Scale-down stabilization window 300s.

stories.title: Create PodDisruptionBudget
stories.details: PDB ensuring at least 1 pod is always available during voluntary disruptions (node maintenance, upgrades).

epics.title: Health Check API Endpoint
epics.summary: Create a /api/health endpoint for Kubernetes liveness and readiness probes.

stories.title: Create health check API route
stories.details: GET /api/health returns { status: 'ok', timestamp, version }. Readiness check verifies Sanity connectivity. Liveness check is lightweight.

epics.title: CI/CD Pipeline for Docker & K8s
epics.summary: GitHub Actions workflow for building Docker images, pushing to registry, and deploying to Kubernetes.

stories.title: Create Docker build & push workflow
stories.details: GitHub Actions workflow that builds Docker image on push to main, pushes to GitHub Container Registry (ghcr.io) with SHA and latest tags.

stories.title: Create Kubernetes deploy workflow
stories.details: GitHub Actions workflow that applies K8s manifests after image is built. Supports staging and production environments via manual approval.

stories.title: Create image scanning workflow
stories.details: Trivy scan on built Docker image. Fail on critical/high vulnerabilities. Upload results as artifacts.

epics.title: Documentation & Scripts
epics.summary: Comprehensive documentation for Docker and Kubernetes deployment procedures.

stories.title: Create deployment documentation
stories.details: Step-by-step guide for: local development with Docker, building images, deploying to K8s, troubleshooting, and rollback procedures.

stories.title: Create Makefile for common operations
stories.details: Makefile targets: build, push, deploy-staging, deploy-prod, status, logs, port-forward, clean.

prerequisites: Docker Desktop or Docker Engine installed
cert-manager installed in cluster for TLS
rollbackPlan: Revert to previous image tag in deployment manifest
Apply previous K8s manifests from git history
